sonnet.problem: The question says "touches that food" and "it becomes ___". Both point back to the food named on card 4, which is no longer on screen. The question never says which food or whose garment, so the baker can't tell what "that food" means.
sonnet.rule: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
